descriptionChirho: To feel jealousy or envy toward another person, a negative emotional response (Acts 7:9 patriarchs jealous of Joseph; Acts 17:5 Jews jealous; 1 Cor 13:4 love does not envy; Jas 4:2 you covet/are jealous; 2 Cor 11:2 godly jealousy).

To eagerly pursue or be ardently devoted to something, a positive striving (1 Cor 12:31 earnestly desire greater gifts; 1 Cor 14:1, 14:39 earnestly desire spiritual gifts; Gal 4:17-18 be zealous; Rev 3:19 be zealous and repent).
